p: said unto Moses: When he called him up to the mountain to give him the laws, beginning at the 20th chapter till now.
And Moses came and told the: When he had received these laws in mount Sinai.
men of the children of Israel: For as yet the priesthood was not given to Levi.
blood of the covenant: Which signifies that the covenant broken cannot be satisfied without shedding of blood.
saw the God of Israel: As perfectly as their infirmities could behold his majesty.
laid not his hand: He did not make them afraid, nor punish them.
did eat and drink: That is, rejoiced.
said unto Moses: The second time.
tables of stone: Signifying the hardness of our hearts, unless God writes his laws in it by his Spirit, Jer 31:33, Eze 11:19, 2Co 3:3, He 8:10,10:16
devouring fire on the top of: The Lord appears like devouring fire to carnal men: but to them that he draws with his Spirit, he is like pleasant sapphire.
